description: How many people live within each drive time of an address, for example 1, 2 and 4 hours. US: 2020 Census block group populations. UK: WorldPop 2020 1 km grid. Drive times from the OSRM router on OpenStreetMap roads (minutes scaled to match Google Maps usual traffic). Returns the count per band, a ready listing sentence, the method and sources. US and UK only; people across a border (Canada, Mexico, Ireland, France) are not counted.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

hours.description: Drive bands in hours. Default [1, 2, 4]. Up to 4 bands, each 0.25 to 5.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

name: who_can_reach
title: People within a drive
